role: ADR 006: the project compiles in Swift 6 language mode with complete strict concurrency in every configuration; check_strict_concurrency_enabled.sh guards the setting and the unchecked-Sendable allowlist counts escapes.

units.key: § ADR 006 — Swift 6 language mode is the concurrency gate
units.does: Claims Swift 6 mode + SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY=complete in all eight configurations, check_strict_concurrency_enabled.sh fails CI if any leaves it, escape count fell from 30 to .ci/unchecked_sendable_budget.txt, and lists the remaining escapes (StrapAPI, WhisperKit feeder, AmbientLocationService, ActiveRouteSession, backups, SessionArchive, BaselineTracker, ConversationStore, SystemDiagnosticsManager, KeyboardPerfSignpost); background readers must use settingsSnapshot. Verified: project.pbxproj has 8 'SWIFT_VERSION = 6.0' and 8 'SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY = complete' lines and 2 warnings-as-errors; budget 14 equals the 14 real annotations.

flags.text: The ADR's enumeration of what remains omits three of the 14 escapes the gate counts: BreadcrumbStore (@unchecked Sendable), WorkoutStartCue.announceSynthesizer (nonisolated(unsafe)) and WCReplyBox (@unchecked Sendable).
